_comment: Dean 25 Oct 2026 - auto-apply rules. Single source, read via scripts/auto_rules.py by build.py, closure.py, full_check.py, publish_gate.py, refresh_guard.py, build_shelters.py, build_warmspaces.py, sweep_daily.py, swep.py, times_finder.py. Refresh stops if this file is missing.

add_new_places.why: Dean 25 Oct 2026: no new place on any layer goes on the map automatically. Held in reports/pending_dean.md; published once its id is in overrides/approved_new_places.json (layer -> {id: note}) or, for food banks, overrides/foodbank_approved_new.json / foodbank_added.json.

closure_card_note: May have closed – call before you go
automatic: clear single new phone on own site
needs_dean: permanent closures (pin kept with card note)
times_auto_apply_why: Dean 27 Oct 2026 07:20 GMT: on, strict. Finder times go on the map only when ALL hold: postcode matched on the page; identical times on 2 separate runs; organisation's own site; no hours conflict; not known times -> closed/empty (plus the older one-block/donation/copy/protected/skip checks). Each change logged to reports/times_auto_applied.json; undo with scripts/times_revert.py <id>. Set false to hold everything for Dean. Anything unclear stays in reports/pending_dean.md. Dean 27 Oct 2026 12:12 GMT: if times cannot be found or read, the stored listing stays exactly as it is (no blank, no closed, no pending row). Dean 27 Oct 2026 12:13 GMT: a stored phone that differs from the site phone is not an hours conflict; only a second, different hours table is. The phone fix stays held on the phone path. Strict form also requires the day on the same line as its times on that page (discover.day_same_line), and every auto-applied change is listed in reports/pending_dean.md for review.
intelligent_mode_why: Dean switched it on 30 Oct 2026 after clean test run 40966669755 (no gate blocks, render errors 4/551 and 5/1030). While on, a thin read (too few source pages, full_check budget exhausted, hours review with no time, or a high share of render errors), or more than 40 auto-applies in one run or one layer, applies nothing from that step. The refresh still publishes. Stale queue rows whose held value already matches the live listing are cleared and not re-applied. Phones and council lines (council_phone, council_ooh, council_label, council_label_cy) are never auto-changed. Each run writes reports/intelligent_mode.json for the 8am digest.

phone_rule.why: Dean 26 Oct 2026 08:29, rule 21, and 08:37: a verified number the venue's own page gives as its contact is shown, including a named person's or personal number, with the label that page gives. A host church contact page counts as that venue's own page. Unverified or doubtful numbers are held with the reason recorded. Dean's own details are never published. Dean 28 Oct 2026 (phone audit, rule change E): a host church page counts as the food bank's own page only when the food bank has no own site (known own sites: overrides/own_location_pages.json _food_bank_own_sites). A number read on a host church page while the food bank has its own site is held.
